pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 5

3. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 17
   C. 21
   D. 3

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

6. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 24
   C. 11
   D. 5

7. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 73
   D. 17

8. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 3, 6, 9
   C. 1, 6
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

9. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 15
   C. 57
   D. 1

10. Solve for x: x + 8 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 8
   C. 11
   D. 10

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 121

12. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 36

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 10

2. C — 25
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 5² = 5 × 5
3. 5² = 25
Final Answer: 25
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. D — 10

4. A — 15
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 12²
3. c² = 81 + 144
4. c² = 225
5. c = 15
Final Answer: 15 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

5. B — 49
Working:

2. Substitute values: 7² = 7 × 7
3. 7² = 49

Working:

2. Substitute values: Product = 8 × 3
3. Product = 24
